claims.text: Greg LaVecchia asserts that 2026 has the lowest barrier to entry in history to start a business, making it the greatest year ever to become an entrepreneur or an intrapreneur within a company. His underlying premise is that entrepreneurial opportunity is universally accessible, not reserved for any particular socioeconomic group.
claims.speaker: Greg LaVecchia
conditions: framed as a response to what differentiates wealthy from non-wealthy mindsets

practices.text: Consider becoming an entrepreneur or intrapreneur in 2026, as the barrier to entry for starting a business is currently at a historic low.
